body:
From forums question: https://forums.xboxlive.com/questions/121031/dxc-compiler-crash-on-invalid-compute-shader.html

Shader code is invalid - shouldn't compile successfully, but crashes DXC without providing an error message. Seems to be related to assigning one RWTexture2D<float4> global variable to another.

Command line:
dxc /Tcs_6_0 /Emain shader.txt

[shader.txt](https://github.com/microsoft/DirectXShaderCompiler/files/6338441/shader.txt)
